description: Orchestrate complex work from an active Antigravity session. The lead owns decomposition, integration, and verification; it routes bounded work to subagents or a workflow script, mechanical work to the lightest tier, and high-stakes or fresh-perspective questions to cross-vendor Claude and Codex peers. Not for routine single-context work. Use when the user explicitly asks to orchestrate, delegate, fan out, parallelize, assign subagents, obtain independent checks, or have the agent act as tech lead.
